name: Riftshard Wolf
description: A hulking wolf-shaped predator whose body is formed from dark crystalline plates and jagged translucent spikes. Violet-blue Rift energy leaks constantly through fractures in its body, leaving luminous trails as it moves.

abilities.name: Rift-Hardened Crystal
abilities.description: When the Riftshard Wolf takes magic damage, halve the incoming damage before comparing it to its damage thresholds. Physical damage affects it normally.

abilities.name: Shardpack
abilities.description: When the Riftshard Wolf makes a successful standard attack against a target with another Riftshard Wolf within Very Close range, add 1d6 physical damage to the damage roll.

abilities.name: Crystal Pounce
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to move from within Close range into Melee range of a target and make an attack. On a success, deal 2d12+4 physical damage and knock the target back to Very Close range.

abilities.name: Rift Eruption
abilities.description: When the Riftshard Wolf marks 2 or more HP from a single attack, unstable Rift magic erupts from its crystalline wounds. All creatures within Melee range must make an Agility Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, they take 1d8+4 magic damage.
